package.description: TextMorph is a free text editor supporting Unicode / UTF-8 (similar to Notepad), but offering additional features ("tools") to quickly change and "format" text either on the open file or across many files at once.

en-US.description: TextMorph is a free text editor supporting Unicode / UTF-8 (similar to Notepad), but offering additional features ("tools") to quickly change and "format" text either on the open file or across many files at once.
en-US.longDescription: Quickly clean up text/emails, convert text to/from HTML, search and replace by words or multiple paragraphs, change upper/lower case, etc. all with the click of a mouse.
en-US.name: Setup
